expandHint: Tap an item to see each request's time and status code

running.title: Testing…
running.body: This takes about 20 seconds. Please stay on this page.

cancelled.title: Test stopped
cancelled.body: You can still copy the results so far for your manager.

noInternet.title: Phone is not online
noInternet.body: Neither the internet nor the server can be reached. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data, make sure a web page opens, then try again.

serverUnreachable.title: Cannot reach the server
serverUnreachable.body: The internet works, but {{host}} cannot be reached. The server address may be wrong, the store network may block it, or the server may be down. Send the report to your manager.

serverUnstable.title: Server connection is unstable
serverUnstable.body: The internet works, but requests to {{host}} failed or varied a lot. Most likely a store line or server line issue — send the report to your manager.

serverSlow.title: Server is responding slowly
serverSlow.body: All requests to {{host}} succeeded, but took {{avg}} on average, so the app will feel slow.

databaseIssue.title: Server is slow internally
databaseIssue.body: The phone reaches the server fine; the server's database is slow. Send the report to your manager.

authExpired.title: Sign-in has expired
authExpired.body: The network is fine, but your sign-in token has expired. Sign out and sign in again.

slowDownload.title: Download speed is slow
slowDownload.body: The connection works but bandwidth is low, so images and lists will load slowly.

imageSlow.title: Product images load slowly
imageSlow.body: The main server is fine, but the product image server (Tencent Cloud) is slow, so images will load slowly.

internetProbeBlocked.title: Server connection is fine
internetProbeBlocked.body: The public test address is unreachable (the store network may block it). This does not affect the app.

allGood.title: Network is fine
allGood.body: Every link is working normally. The app should run smoothly.

report.copied: Copied to clipboard — paste it into a message to your manager
report.copyFailed: Copy failed. Long-press the report text to copy it manually.
